High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Fonts API.

Provides access to system fonts and custom font loading/unloading.

Imports

../ffi

Procs

proc getSystemFont(fontKey: cstring): GFont {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}

Get a system font by its key constant. Equivalent to C function ffi.fonts_get_system_font(font_key).

Common font keys (re-exported from FFI):

  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_14
  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_18
  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_18_BOLD
  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_24
  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_24_BOLD
  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_28
  • FONT_KEY_GOTHIC_28_BOLD
  • FONT_KEY_BITHAM_30_BLACK
  • FONT_KEY_BITHAM_42_BOLD
  • FONT_KEY_BITHAM_42_LIGHT
  • FONT_KEY_ROBOTO_CONDENSED_21
  • FONT_KEY_ROBOTO_BOLD_SUBSET_49
  • FONT_KEY_DROID_SERIALIZE_28_BOLD
proc loadCustomFont(handle: ResHandle): GFont {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Load a custom font from a resource handle. Equivalent to C function ffi.fonts_load_custom_font(handle). 
proc unloadCustomFont(font: GFont) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Unload a custom font and free its memory. Equivalent to C function ffi.fonts_unload_custom_font(font).
